blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur — The police in the Caraga region arrested four wanted persons in separate operations across the region on Monday. Brig. Gen. Rolindo Suguilon, Police Regional Office-13 (PRO-13) director, said the suspects are wanted for alleged sexual offenses, illegal drugs and robbery. In Dinagat Islands, personnel of the Loreto Municipal Police Station arrested alias “Titing,” 31, ranked No. 8 on the regional most wanted list, in Purok 4, Barangay Carmen. He was charged with eight counts of acts of lasciviousness. Bail was set at P200,000. In Marihatag, Surigao del Sur, police arrested alias “Amboy,” 51, ranked No. […]...
